note: A1+ Unit 7 Lesson 7.14, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. On 2026-11-20 the user asked to "work on a1+ Unit 7 same all deal as before none stop all approved": the A1+ Unit 7 map (A1+ 7.Y follows A1 7.Y, one step each, fifteen lessons) approved up front, straight to Preview, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. The review uses twelve new Flash photos of new people, one per Unit 7 step: a man rubbing his arms after carrying boxes, a girl drinking water at football, a young man in a yellow jacket, a woman pulling on a raincoat at a café door in the rain, an older woman painting in her garden, a boy holding out a football to invite a friend, a tourist puzzled at a museum desk, a boy coughing in bed, three cats from biggest to smallest, a dog swimming in a lake, a chef flipping a pan and two children swimming in summer. Each fact is offered as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form.

lesson.title: 7.14 Review: a busy day
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 7 step with new people: what hurts, why, what people are wearing, the weather now, putting clothes on, likes + -ing, polite invitations and repair, being sick, the seasons, the -est, can and good at, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.14 Three Everyday Situations: A1 reviews Unit 7 in fresh situations; A1+ 7.14 reviews every A1+ Unit 7 step with twelve fresh photos of new people and no new language: His arms hurt. and What's wrong with him? (7.1), Why …? Because … (7.2), wearing (7.3), It's raining. (7.4), putting on (7.5), likes + -ing (7.6), Would you like to …? (7.7), Could you speak slowly, please? (7.8), has a cough and feels sick (7.9), in summer (7.10), the biggest and the smallest (7.11), can (7.12) and good at (7.13). Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say what is wrong, what people wear and like, the weather, invitations and requests, and what people and animals can do, with every Unit 7 form, at a natural pace.
